faqs.q: How does the City decide where to add bike lanes?
faqs.a: The City must comply with the Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices (MUTCD) standards for all bike facilities. Additionally, the City maintains a Bicycle Master Plan and is completing a Transportation System Plan, both of which help identify areas of opportunity and help inform planning for improvements related to cycling infrastructure in Arvada.
